spans.s:
वध् वध् (a defective rt. frequently
written बध्, see 3. बध्, properly only
used in the Aorist and Precative tenses, the other tenses
being supplied fr. rt. हन्, q. v.), Aor. P. A. अव-
धीत्, अवधिष्ट, (मा वधिष्ठाः, do not kill);
Prec. 1

st sing. वध्यासम्, 3rd sing. वध्यात्, (in
the Veda the Potential also occurs, e. g. 1st sing.
वधेयम्, 3rd sing. वधेत्; in epic poetry the
2nd Fut. P. A. वधिष्यति, -ते, and some tenses
and forms of the Pass.; other Vedic forms are व-
धीम्, वधिष्टन), to strike; to slay, kill, put
to death, destroy, murder: Pass. वध्यते (ep. P.
वध्यति), 3rd sing. Impv. वध्यताम्, Aor. अव-
धि, Prec. वधिषीष्ट, to be slain or killed: Caus.
वध्यति, -यितुम्, to kill, slay; [cf. according to
some, Lat. lœdo: Hib. fœthaim, ‘I kill;’ fœthadh,
‘killing;’ fesaim, ‘I kill, destroy;’ feadhm, ‘kill-
ing.’]

वाध् वाध् (more correctly written बाध्,
q. v.), cl. 1. A. वाधते, ववाधे, वा-
धिष्यते, अवाधिष्ट, वाधितुम्, to press, oppress,
vex, give pain, distress.

वध, अस्, m. one who kills or slays, a killer,
slaughterer; a vanquisher, victor; a deadly weapon,
Indra's thunderbolt (Ved.); the act of striking, kill-
ing, slaying, slaughter, murder, death, destruction;
a blow, stroke, corporal punishment; paralysis;
destruction, disappearance (said of inanimate objects);
multiplication.
—वध-कर्माधिकारिन् (˚म-
अध्˚), ई, m. ‘one who superintends the act of put-
ting to death,’ an executioner, hangman.
—वध-
काङ्क्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, wishing for death.
—वध-
काम्या, f. the desire to kill, intention to hurt.
—वध-जीविन्, ई, इनी, इ, living by the death (of
animals); (ई), m. a butcher; a hunter, fowler.
 — 1. वध-त्र, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. वधत्र
see col. 3), protecting from death or destruction.
—वध-दण्ड, capital punishment; corporal
punishment (e. g. whipping &c., Manu
VIII. 129

).
—वध-निर्णेक, अस्, m. expiation for killing,
atonement for murder or manslaughter.
—वध-
भूमि, इस्, f. execution-ground, place of execution.
—वध-स्थली, f. or वध-स्थान, अम्, n. a
place of execution; a slaughter-house.
—वधाङ्-
गक (˚ध-अङ्˚), अम्, n. a prison.
—वधार्ह
(˚ध-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, deserving death.
—वधै-
षिन् (˚ध-एष्˚), ई, इणी, इ, desirous of killing, in-
tending to kill.
—वधोदर्क (˚ध-उद्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, resulting in death, effecting death.
—वधोद्यत
(˚ध-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, prepared or ready to kill,
intending to put to death, murderous; an assassin,
murderer.
—वधोपाय (˚ध-उप्˚), अस्, m. an in-
strument or means of putting to death.

वधा वधा, ind. a various reading for
वध्वा, q. v.
वाधा, f. pain, affliction, opposition. (See बाध.)

वधक, अस्, अका or इका, अम्, killing, destructive,
pernicious, injurious; (अस्), m. one who kills, a
[]
murderer, assassin; an executioner, hangman, (also
written बधक); a particular sort of reed or rush.

2. वधत्र, अम्, n. (for 1. वध-त्र see
col. 2), ‘an instrument of death,’ deadly weapon,
dart.
वधना, f., Ved. a deadly weapon.

वाधन, अम्, n. the act of oppressing, paining,
vexing, &c. (See बाधन.)

वधर्, n., Ved. a destructive weapon, the weapon
or thunderbolt of Indra, a thunderbolt (= वज्र).

वधर्य, Nom. P. वधर्यति, &c., to desire
the thunderbolt of Indra.

वधर्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, desiring the thunderbolt
of Indra; (अन्ती), f. ‘casting a bolt,’ i. e. (according
to some) lightning; (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda
) a line of clouds or the earth.
वधस् = वधर् above.

वधस्न (apparently only used in the inst. pl.
वधस्नैस्), Ved. a destructive or deadly weapon,
the weapon of Indra.

वधस्नु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. bearing a deadly
weapon, (Sāy. = प्रहारेण प्रस्रवण-शील.)
वधिक, musk.

वधित्र, अम्, n. the god of love, love, sexual
love.

वधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, incurring death, killed by, (at
the end of a comp.)

वध्य, अस्, आ, अम् (frequently written बध्य),
to be slain or killed, to be put to death, punished
with death; to be punished or chastised, to be cor-
porally punished, subject to corporal punishment;
vulnerable, liable to be killed, to be destroyed, to
be annihilated; (अस्), m. an enemy.
—वध्य-घ्न,
अस्, m. killing one sentenced to death, carrying out
the duties of public executioner.
—वध्य-ता, f. or
वध्य-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being sentenced to
be killed or of deserving death; fitness to be killed;
destruction.
—वध्य-पटह, अस्, m. a drum
beaten at the time of the execution of a criminal.
—वध्य-भू, ऊस्, or वध्य-भूमि, इस्, f. a
place of public execution.
—वध्य-माला, f. a gar-
land placed on one condemned to death or about to
be executed.
—वध्य-वासस्, अस्, n. the clothes of
a criminal who has been executed (given to a Caṇ-
ḍāla, Manu

).
—वध्य-शिला, f. a stone or
rock on which malefactors are executed, executioner's
block, scaffold; a slaughter-house, shambles.
—व-
ध्य-स्थान, अम्, n. a place of execution.
वध्य वध्य, &c. See p. 882, col. 3.

वध्या, f. killing, murder; [cf. आत्म-व्˚, ब्रह्-
म-व्˚.]
वध्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, being struck, being killed.

वध्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being killed, being
destroyed.

वध्रि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. ‘one whose testicles are
cut out, ‘castrated, emasculated, unmanly (= छिन्न-
मुष्क, opposed to वृषन्).
—वध्रि-मती, f.
(fem. of an unused form वध्रि-मत्), Ved. having
an impotent husband; a proper N.
—वध्रि-वाच्,
क्, क्, क्, Ved. speaking unmanly or useless words, idly
talking, (Sāy. = जल्पक.)
—वध्र्य्-अश्व, अस्, m.
‘having castrated horses,’ a proper N.; (आस्), m. pl.
the family of Vadhry-aśva.
वध्रि वध्रि, &c. See p. 882, col. 3.
वध्रिका, m. (Pāṇ.
Vārtt. 3

), a cas-
trated person, eunuch.
वधु वधु, वधुका. See p. 883, col. 1.

वधु, उस्, or वधुका, f. = वधू, a young wife
or woman in general; a son's wife, daughter-in-law.

वधू वधू, ऊस्, f. (fr. वध् = rt. 1. वह्; or,
according to others, fr. rt. बन्ध्, and then more
properly written बधू), a bride or newly mar-
ried woman (as ‘recently brought or led home’), a
young wife, spouse; a woman in general, female,
girl, maiden, (in Ṛg-veda
VIII. 19, 36

. perhaps ‘a
handmaid’ or ‘female slave’ or, according to some,
‘a mare or animal used for draught;’ cf. वधू-
मत्); the female of any animal (e. g. मृग-
वधू, the female of a deer, cf. व्याघ्र-व्˚); a
daughter-in-law; the wife of a younger relation,
younger brother's wife, nephew's wife, younger
female relation; N. of various plants, Trigonella
Corniculata; Echites Frutescens; Curuma Zerumbet;
[]
[cf. Hib. badhbh, ‘an evil-minded woman, witch.’]
—वधू-काल, अस्, m. the time during which a
woman is held to be a bride.
—वधू-गृह-प्र-
वेश or वधू-प्रवेश, अस्, m. the ceremony of the
entrance of a bride into the house of her husband.
—वधू-जन, अस्, m. a woman, female, wife.
—वधू-दर्श, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. looking at a
bride.
—वधू-पक्ष, अस्, m. the party or side of
the bride (at a wedding).
—वधू-पथ, अस्, m.,
Ved. the path or way of a bride.
—वधू-मत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having or possessing a wife, ac-
companied by a wife, having women; furnished or
harnessed with yoke animals or with female animals
suitable for draught; fit for harness, suitable for the
yoke.
—वधू-वस्त्र, अम्, n. bridal apparel.
—व-
धू-सरा, f., N. of a river (fabled to have sprung
from the weeping eyes of Pulomā, wife of Bhṛgu).

वाधू वाधू, ऊस्, f. (probably connected
with rt. 1. वह्), a vessel, boat, raft.

वधुटी or वधूटी, f. a young woman living in
her father's house (whether married or not); a son's
wife, daughter-in-law.

वधूयु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. one who loves his wife,
longing for a wife, desiring marriage, eager to marry,
uxorious, lustful; one who seeks a wife, a wooer,
suitor.
वध्वती, f. = वधूटी.

वधूटशयन वधूटशयन, अस्, m. a lattice,
window.

वध्न वध्न, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people,
(more correctly written वध्र.)

वध्र वध्र, अम्, n. (more properly written
बध्र, q. v.), a leathern strap or thong; lead; (ई),
f. a leathern strap or thong, (sometimes spelt वद्-
ध्री.)
वध्रक, lead.
वध्रस्व, a various reading for वध्र्य्-अश्व.

वध्र्य, अस्, m. (also written बध्र्य), a shoe,
slipper.
वध्वा वध्वा, ind., see Gaṇa Cādi to Pāṇ.

वाधुक्य वाधुक्य, अम्, n. (fr. वधुका),
marriage.

वाधूय वाधूय, अम्, n. (fr. वधू), Ved. a
bride's garment, bridal dress.

वाध्रीणस वाध्रीणस, अस्, m. a rhinoceros;
(according to some also वाध्रीनस.)

वाध्र्यश्व, अस्, m. (fr. वध्र्य्-अश्व), a patro-
nymic.
